card.name: The word oral before a drug
card.fires_on: The word "oral" (or "Oral") used as a modifier right before a drug name, dose, or form such as contraceptives, dose, suspension. It appears in interaction and dosing sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Oral after a dose amount
modes.description: "oral" follows a single-dose amount and comes before dose or a drug name.

modes.description: "Oral" or "oral" introduces a named drug in dose selection or starting dose statements.
